farm_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory that contains every animal's data subdirectory

farm_base_domain.description: Root domain of the farm; animals appear as subdomains or path segments below this

url_detection_mode.description: Animal-detection strategy: 'domain' reads the subdomain, 'path' reads the first URL path segment

default_animal.description: Animal name to serve when no URL pattern matches; leave empty to serve the base DokuWiki installation

animals.description: Ordered list of animal wiki instances hosted by this farm

key.description: URL key — the subdomain label or path segment that routes requests to this animal

dir.description: Subdirectory name inside farm_dir where this animal's pages and config live

base_url.description: Canonical base URL of this animal (scheme + host, no trailing slash)

description.description: Human-readable label written as a comment above each animal entry in the config

memory_limit.description: PHP memory_limit per request; increase for large wikis with heavy plugins or full-text indexing

upload_max_filesize.description: Maximum size of a single file upload in the DokuWiki media manager (e.g. 32M, 128M)

post_max_size.description: Maximum total HTTP POST body size; must be at least as large as upload_max_filesize

max_execution_time.description: Per-request PHP execution time limit in seconds; 0 disables the limit (not recommended in production)

session_cookie_lifetime.description: Browser-side session cookie lifetime in seconds; 0 means the cookie is deleted when the browser closes

session_gc_maxlifetime.description: Server-side idle-session expiry in seconds; sessions inactive longer than this are garbage-collected

session_cookie_secure.description: Restrict session cookies to HTTPS-only; disable only if the farm is not behind TLS

error_reporting_mask.description: PHP error_reporting expression; E_ALL & ~E_NOTICE is recommended — suppresses harmless notices without hiding real errors

display_errors.description: Whether PHP errors are rendered in the browser response; must be false in production
